Export fixtures — standalone browser test pages

Each link below is a real, standalone exported component — produced by the same compiler the app's own "Download .HTML File" button uses (scripts/generate-export-fixtures.mjs → js/preview.js#generateIframeContent), not a hand-written approximation. Open one directly in a browser to manually check it the same way a real exported file would behave.

These are NOT Rise or Moodle. Opening one of these confirms the exported file works as a plain web page — see docs/RISE-COMPATIBILITY-MATRIX.md for what is and isn't verified beyond that, and docs/RISE-TEST-CHECKLIST.md / docs/MOODLE-SCORM-TEST-CHECKLIST.md for the manual steps that actually exercise Rise/Moodle.

For each fixture, try:

  • Click every interactive control (accordion header, quiz option, hotspot pin, tab, etc.).
  • Tab to the component using only the keyboard, then activate controls with Enter/Space/arrow keys — no mouse.
  • Resize the window narrow (under 400px) and confirm nothing overflows or becomes unusable.
  • Open your browser devtools console and confirm there are no errors.
  • Accordion
  • Flip Cards
  • Tabs
  • Multiple Choice
  • Hotspots
  • Vertical Timeline
  • Audio Player

These same files are also loaded automatically by tests/e2e/exported-fixtures.spec.js (console-error, keyboard-operability, and offline-font-fallback checks) and validated for drift by tests/unit/export-fixtures.test.js. Regenerate with npm run fixtures:exports after changing any of the 7 components listed above, then commit the updated files.
